title: Gradient-Gated DPO: Stabilizing Preference Optimization in Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.02626v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) improves relative preference by increasing the margin between chosen and rejected responses, but this objective does not specify how probability mass should be redistributed to achieve that margin. Consequently, preference separation can improve even as probability mass collapses away from both preferred and unrelated responses, a phenomenon associated with the squeezing effect. We show that this pathology is localized: continued negative updates become destructive when rejected responses enter low-probability valleys, where further suppression induces harmful redistribution through the coupled softmax geometry. We introduce Gradient-Gated Preference Optimization (Gate-DPO), which uses the current probability geometry of each rejected response to selectively attenuate its contribution, limiting excessive rejected suppression while delaying preference-loss saturation. Gate-DPO is objective-agnostic

translated_title: 梯度门控DPO：稳定语言模型中的偏好优化
translated_abstract: 直接偏好优化通过增大被选择响应与被拒绝响应之间的边际来改善相对偏好，但该目标函数并未规定概率质量应如何重新分配以实现这一边际。因此，即使概率质量从被偏好响应和不相关响应中同时坍缩，偏好分离程度仍可能得到改善，这一现象与“挤压效应”相关。我们证明这种病理现象是局部化的：当被拒绝响应进入低概率谷区时，持续的负向更新会变得具有破坏性，因为进一步的抑制会通过耦合的softmax几何结构引发有害的概率重新分配。我们提出梯度门控偏好优化，它利用每个被拒绝响应当前的概率几何结构来选择性地衰减其贡献，从而限制对被拒绝响应的过度抑制，同时延缓偏好损失的饱和。Gate-DPO与目标函数无关
tldr: 提出Gate-DPO方法，利用被拒绝响应的概率几何信息选择性衰减其梯度贡献，防止DPO训练中因过度抑制被拒绝响应导致的概率质量坍缩，从而稳定偏好优化。
en_tdlr: Proposes Gate-DPO, which selectively attenuates gradient contributions of rejected responses based on their probability geometry, preventing probability mass collapse from over-suppression and stabilizing preference optimization in DPO training.
